# E0803: a version in the playground request is not a version

A version in a request is written <major>.<minor>. A version that parses but
that the lineage lacks is E0240 instead.

## Example

`request.json`:

```json
{"lineage": {"normal": {"path": "lineage.cue", "text": "name: \"ship\"\nschemas: {\n\t\"0\": {\n\t\t\"0\": {\n\t\t\tschema: {\n\t\t\t\tcrew: int\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n"}}, "data": {"filename": "data.json", "text": "{\"crew\": 1}"}, "version": "1"}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0803]: "1" is not a version
  |
  = help: a version is <major>.<minor>, such as 1.0
```
